predictions.articleTitle: Millwall vs Lincoln Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Imps Survive The Den? — Scoreline & xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Millwall will capitalize on Lincoln's severe defensive suspensions and short turnaround to secure a controlled, low-scoring home victory.

Under 2.5 Total Goals due to extensive attacking injuries on both sides (Confidence: High, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Millwall host exhausted Lincoln battling severe suspensions after midweek 0-6 demolition.

spf.comment: Millwall's superior physical preparation and set-piece prowess will overcome an exhausted, suspension-depleted Lincoln side.

over_under.comment: Attacking injuries to Millwall's strikers and Lincoln's ultra-defensive posture heavily suppress the projected total goal count.

score.comment: A 1:0 grind represents the modal probability, with a 2:0 late breakthrough covering the primary secondary fatigue branch.

goals.comment: The game state is heavily concentrated in the low-scoring band of exactly 1 or 2 total goals.

bqc.comment: Lincoln's initial resistance should maintain first-half parity before severe physical fatigue enables Millwall's second-half win.
